checkpoint: MapLibre iOS feature-state lifetime fixture repair
classification: Fixture sequencing defect exposed by documented deferred native SDK removal, not a facade/wrapper key-forwarding defect. No production library or peer patch change.

trace.fixture: examples/shared/lifetimes-smoke.ts used to unconditionally remove each destination feature after transitions, including already-empty state. Its empty-state read could pass before the queued clear applied.
trace.facade: packages/one-map-react/src/adapters/maplibre-native/feature-state-methods.ts forwards the current family source ref, feature identifier and selected key unchanged.
trace.wrapper: Retained @maplibre/maplibre-react-native 11.5.0 GeoJSONSource.tsx forwards key through NativeGeoJSONSourceModule, MLRNGeoJSONSourceModule.mm and MLRNGeoJSONSource.m to removeFeatureStateForFeatureID:stateKey:. Vector source forwarding was inspected as the control. Wrapper docs explicitly defer removal to the next rendered frame.
trace.sdk: ios-v6.31.0 MLNShapeSource.mm and MLNVectorTileSource.mm forward to MLNSource.mm, then renderer SourceFeatureState. getState merges pending writes without applying deletedStates; coalesceChanges merges writes then applies deletions. An empty whole clear stays pending, allowing a later set/get to report count=2 before coalescence deletes it. A subsequent keyed remove does not replace that pending whole clear.
trace.identityLimit: SDK source is pinned to the 6.31.0 release tag matching retained dependency pins; this diagnosis does not independently authenticate the binary used by the failed attempt.

sourceBackedProbe.method: Compile all exact pinned SourceFeatureState methods after removing only their include directives. Declare their class and standard-map state types locally; replace feature values with int and stub the unused empty tile list callback and trace macro. No SDK, app, simulator or renderer constructed.
sourceBackedProbe.red: Original whole-clear-empty -> set(selected=1,count=2) -> get(count=2) -> remove(selected) -> coalesce -> get: selected absent, count absent; assertion abort exit -6.
sourceBackedProbe.green: Only skip the initially empty whole clear; identical subsequent sequence yields selected absent and count=2, exit 0.
sourceBackedProbe.limit: Isolated exact SDK state methods prove the queue interaction, not native bridge transport, rendering, source attachment or runtime completion.
